integrity: Same mathematical model proof and original executable checks only. No independent mathematical audit, priority certification, or external formal verification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact and asymptotic theorem is for ordered semigroup-inverse pairs in the chain-isotone full transformation monoid. It does not determine the number of inverse matchings and makes no claim for general posets. The kernel-transversal crossed-square description and rank-idempotent counts are previously published. The 1998 Lavers chapter was accessible only by abstract and preview, and a 1993 Higgins text was only partially readable; an older implicit treatment of some refinements remains a priority risk.
title: Golden-ratio ranks and Pell ties for mutual inverses of isotone maps
